messages:
mike: FYI customer just asked to add two things to the POC mid-flight: prefix caching + quantized model to hit cost targets, and they want BYO-KMS for keys. they also bumped success metrics: 99th latency target tightened. need quick alignment on tradeoffs and pricing delta.
priya: Thanks — can you share the new SLO numbers? caching + quantization is doable but we'll need to validate quality on their eval set. BYO-KMS adds networking and key-access latency.
mike: They want p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms, and semantic accuracy >= 0.88 on their prompt set. current baseline from our hosted model: p50 120ms, p95 400ms, accuracy 0.90.
alana: @mike @priya security note: BYO-KMS for Dedicated/Private is fine but on Hosted we'd need a VPC endpoint or customer-managed proxy. also need to confirm key rotation policy and audit logs — Qs on their SOC2 boundary.
irene: Pricing: quantized model can cut token compute by ~30-45% depending on format (int8 vs q4). Dedicated + BYO-KMS raises the monthly minimum (networking + egress overhead) — rough ballpark delta: +20-35% on committed cost. I'll get a more exact quote if you share expected token volumes.
sam: Operational tradeoffs: caching helps p50/p95 for repeat prefixes but can increase p99 tail if cache-miss handling adds variance. Batching increases throughput but also tail latency for interactive flows. For their p99 goal we should avoid aggressive batching on the interactive route.
priya: Quick plan: 1) run the eval suite with q4_0 quantized model and original prompts (need dataset) 2) enable prefix KV caching in a staging route and measure p95/p99 3) test BYO-KMS latency (simulate via a proxy) 4) propose gated rollout: staging canary -> 10% -> 50% with auto-fallback to float32 if accuracy drops. Anyone object?
mike: No objections. I'll ask customer to upload a ~500 prompt eval set (mix of short/long contexts). also asked them to share expected RPS.
alana: Add to security questionnaire: key custody diagram, network path, and whether KMS is on-prem or cloud-managed. we need that to decide if Hosted can be approved or if Private is required.
irene: If they commit to 300M tokens/mo, I can model costs for three configs: hosted float32, hosted quantized, dedicated+BYO-KMS. send volumes and I'll table numbers by EOD. :+1:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/caching-experiment -> 2026-02-12 21:40 UTC (job #4789).
priya: For the eval script, here's a suggested pass/fail block to automate regression checks:
```
metrics:
  - avg_accuracy >= 0.88
  - p50 <= 80ms
  - p95 <= 250ms
  - p99 <= 500ms
fallback_policy: roll-back-on-fail
```
priya: Note: accuracy may drop ~1-2% on q4 for some prompts; if that happens we can try mixed precision fallback or a hybrid routing (quantized for cheaper, float32 for top-k uncertain responses).
mike: Customer is worried about hallucinations in rerank cases if accuracy degrades. can we add an eval that checks rerank precision@1?
priya: Yes — ask them for labeled pairs. we'll add precision@1 >= 0.85 as a gated metric.
irene: Also flag: BYO-KMS may introduce per-request latency of ~5-15ms depending on region; include that in p99 calculations.
sam: Recommendation: don't enable both aggressive batching and strict p99 SLO on the same route. tune batch size to keep p99 headroom, use caching for common prefixes, and fallback routing in case of degradation.
mike: I'll push the request for eval dataset + volumes + KMS topology. expect customer to reply tomorrow. thanks all. :pray:
priya: I'll prep the staging config and an evaluation notebook. will post results in this thread once deploy finishes. :rocket:
